effects: Casts the signer's vote, For or Against, on Gitcoin GovernorAlpha proposal `proposalId`. Anyone who holds the signature can submit it through castVoteBySig.
The vote weight is the signer's GTC voting power at the proposal's start block (gtc.getPriorVotes). It is added to forVotes or againstVotes.
The signer's receipt for that proposal is set to hasVoted=true, so the vote cannot be changed or cast again. No tokens move and no approvals change.
formats.shown: "Cast vote on Gitcoin proposal", with Proposal id shown as a raw number and Vote shown as For or Against.

findings.title: Ballot has no interpolatedIntent, so the glance line hides the vote direction and the proposal id.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json display.formats.Ballot: "intent": "Cast vote on Gitcoin proposal" and no interpolatedIntent. The direction (support) and proposalId are only in the fields.

findings.title: Ballot vote weight comes from the signer's past GTC delegation and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: GovernorAlpha.sol _castVote: `uint96 votes = gtc.getPriorVotes(voter, proposal.startBlock);`. This is read from storage, not from the message.

findings.title: The Ballot signature has no nonce or deadline, so anyone can relay it at any time while voting is open.
findings.evidence: GovernorAlpha.sol castVoteBySig: structHash = keccak256(abi.encode(BALLOT_TYPEHASH, proposalId, support)). The message has no expiry field. _castVote only checks that the state is Active and that the voter has not voted yet.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. A label or intent note could say the vote is final once relayed.
